account_gender_check.name: account_gender_check
account_gender_check.value: "account"."gender" in ('sister', 'brother') or ("account"."gender" = 'none' and cardinality("account"."roles") > 0 and "account"."roles" <@ ARRAY['moderator', 'operator']::text[])

report_target_shape_check.name: report_target_shape_check
report_target_shape_check.value: ("report"."target_kind" = 'profile' and "report"."target_id" = "report"."reported_account_id" and "report"."conversation_id" is null) or ("report"."target_kind" = 'message' and "report"."conversation_id" is not null)

session_mfa_state_check.name: session_mfa_state_check
session_mfa_state_check.value: ("session"."kind" = 'staff' and "session"."mfa_state" is not null and "session"."mfa_state" in ('password_change', 'enroll', 'verify', 'done')) or ("session"."kind" <> 'staff' and "session"."mfa_state" is null)
